parts.title: Orientation
parts.summary: What Georgian is, the idea that runs through its grammar (the verb is the sentence), and how this guide works.

parts.title: Sounds and script
parts.summary: Five vowels, the three-way stop contrast with ejectives, consonant clusters, the Mkhedruli alphabet in stages, and the transliteration used here.

parts.title: The simplest sentences
parts.summary: Saying what something is, the first verbs in the present, subject and object marking in series I, negation, questions and plurals.

parts.title: Nouns and their machinery
parts.summary: The seven cases and the postpositions built on them, noun stem types and syncope, pronouns, possessives, demonstratives, adjective agreement and question words.

parts.title: Verbs: the core system
parts.summary: The verb template, object markers, preverbs and the future, the three series and eleven screeves, the four verb classes, the ergative and inversion, version, and the irregular verbs.

parts.title: Modifying and linking
parts.summary: Adverbs, comparison, numbers and time, postpositions, conjunctions and particles, participles, the masdar, reflexives and word formation.

parts.title: Complex sentences
parts.summary: Relative and complement clauses, reported speech, time, purpose, cause and concession, real and unreal conditions, and the subjunctive screeves.

parts.title: Advanced and special topics
parts.summary: Causatives, stative and relative intransitives, three-person verbs in series III, honorific verbs, number-suppletive verbs, colloquial speech, dialects, the Kartvelian family and a short note on Old Georgian.

parts.title: Reading real texts
parts.summary: Seven graded passages, from proverbs and the Universal Declaration of Human Rights to Ilia Chavchavadze, Akaki Tsereteli, Baratashvili and two stanzas of Rustaveli.

parts.title: Reference
parts.summary: Declension and screeve tables for every verb class, core vocabulary, glossary of terms and abbreviations, annotated bibliography.

lessons.title: What Georgian is
lessons.point: Place Georgian in time, space and family, and know which Georgian this guide teaches

lessons.title: The organising idea: the verb is the sentence
lessons.point: See how one verb carries its people, direction and tense, and why tense decides the case of the nouns

lessons.title: How to use this guide
lessons.point: Read the transliteration, the interlinear glosses and the confidence dots, and know where the facts come from

lessons.title: Five vowels and the syllable
lessons.point: Pronounce the five vowels and count syllables, knowing that stress is weak and never changes a vowel

lessons.title: Three kinds of stop: voiced, aspirated, ejective
lessons.point: Hear and make the contrast between b, p and ṗ, and between d, t and ṭ, g, k and ḳ

lessons.title: Affricates, fricatives and the back of the mouth
lessons.point: Pronounce the three ts-sounds and three ch-sounds, and q̇, x and ɣ, and v in its variants

lessons.title: Consonant clusters
lessons.point: Pronounce long initial clusters and recognise harmonic clusters, which release as one sound

lessons.title: Mkhedruli, stage one: vowels and sonorants
lessons.point: Read and write the vowel letters and m, n, l, r, v, s, h, and words made of them

lessons.title: Mkhedruli, stage two: the stops
lessons.point: Read and write the nine stop letters and see how the alphabet sorts them

lessons.title: Mkhedruli, stage three: the rest of the alphabet
lessons.point: Read and write the affricates and back consonants, recite the alphabet in order and read any word

lessons.title: Three scripts and one transliteration
lessons.point: Know Asomtavruli, Nuskhuri and Mtavruli, why there are no capitals, and convert between Mkhedruli and this guide's transliteration

lessons.title: This is a house: the nominative and 'is'
lessons.point: Name things and say what something is with the nominative and the copula არის / -ა

lessons.title: I am, you are: persons and pronouns
lessons.point: Say who you are with ვარ, ხარ, არის and the personal pronouns, and meet the person marker v-

lessons.title: No gender, no articles
lessons.point: Use nouns without articles or gender, and use ერთი for 'a certain'

lessons.title: More than one: the plural -ებ-
lessons.point: Make plurals with -ებ- and keep the noun singular after numbers and 'many'

lessons.title: The first verb: I write, you write
lessons.point: Conjugate a transitive verb in the present with v-, -s and -t, with the subject in the nominative

lessons.title: What you act on: the dative object
lessons.point: Put the direct object in the dative in the present and build full subject-object-verb sentences

lessons.title: Saying no: არ and ვერ
lessons.point: Negate statements with არ, and say you cannot with ვერ

lessons.title: Yes-no questions and answers
lessons.point: Ask yes-no questions by intonation and with ხომ, and answer with კი, დიახ and არა

lessons.title: Word order and dropped pronouns
lessons.point: Vary word order for emphasis and leave out pronouns the verb already shows

lessons.title: Review: part 2 as a whole
lessons.point: Translate a passage and build and correct sentences using everything taught so far

lessons.title: The seven cases at a glance
lessons.point: See the seven cases as one system of endings and what each does in a sentence

lessons.title: In, on, at, like: postpositions on the dative
lessons.point: Say where things are with -ში, -ზე, -თან and -ვით

lessons.title: Of and for: the genitive
lessons.point: Show possession with -ის and use -თვის, -გან and -კენ

lessons.title: With and as: the instrumental and adverbial
lessons.point: Use -ით for means and -ად for 'as, into', and -დან and -მდე for 'from' and 'up to'

lessons.title: Nouns ending in a vowel
lessons.point: Decline nouns in -ა, -ე, -ო and -უ, and know which ones lose their final vowel

lessons.title: Disappearing vowels: syncope
lessons.point: Predict when a noun like მეგობარი loses a vowel (მეგობრის) and check it when you cannot

lessons.title: Calling someone: the vocative
lessons.point: Address people with -ო and -ვ, and with bare names

lessons.title: My, your, our: pronouns and possessives
lessons.point: Use me, šen and the others in every case they have, and the possessives ჩემი, შენი, მისი, ჩვენი, თქვენი, მათი

lessons.title: This, that, that over there
lessons.point: Use the three-way ეს / ეგ / ის and their oblique forms ამ, მაგ, იმ

lessons.title: Adjectives before the noun
lessons.point: Put adjectives before nouns and give them the shortened endings they take there

lessons.title: Who, what, where: question words and indefinites
lessons.point: Ask with ვინ, რა, სად, როდის, რატომ, როგორ, and say someone, nobody, something, nothing

lessons.title: The old plural in -ნ- and -თ-
lessons.point: Recognise the stylistically marked plural of formal writing and set phrases

lessons.title: Review: part 3 as a whole
lessons.point: Translate a passage and build and correct sentences using everything taught so far

lessons.title: Anatomy of the verb
lessons.point: See the slots of the verb template and which slot holds which meaning

lessons.title: Thematic suffixes and the present stem
lessons.point: Find the present stem by its thematic suffix (-ებ, -ობ, -ავ, -ამ, -ი and none)

lessons.title: Me, you, us: object markers
lessons.point: Mark the object on the verb with მ-, გ-, გვ- and zero, and say 'you see me'

lessons.title: Who gets the plural -თ
lessons.point: Work out which person a plural -თ belongs to, and why ვ- and გ- never appear together

lessons.title: Was doing: the imperfect
lessons.point: Form and use the imperfect with -დ-

lessons.title: Preverbs and the future
lessons.point: Add a preverb to the present to make the future and see what the preverbs mean

lessons.title: Would do: the conditional
lessons.point: Form the conditional from the future stem with -დ-

lessons.title: Series and screeves: the map of the verb
lessons.point: Name the eleven screeves, group them into three series, and know which you have already learnt

lessons.title: Four kinds of verb
lessons.point: Sort verbs into transitive, unaccusative, unergative and indirect, and know why the class matters for case

lessons.title: Things that happen: class 2 in the present and future
lessons.point: Form unaccusative verbs with ი-, with -დ- and without a marker (იწერება, კვდება)

lessons.title: Going and coming
lessons.point: Use მიდის, მოდის, წავა and the hither/thither preverbs მი- and მო-

lessons.title: What happened: the aorist and the ergative
lessons.point: Form the aorist of transitive verbs and put their subject in the ergative and their object in the nominative

lessons.title: Review: putting it together so far
lessons.point: Translate, build and correct sentences using everything taught up to here

lessons.title: The aorist of intransitives
lessons.point: Form the aorist of class 2 verbs, whose subject stays nominative, and know strong from weak aorists

lessons.title: Doing without an object: medial verbs
lessons.point: Use class 3 verbs like თამაშობს and მუშაობს, which take the ergative in the aorist though they have no object

lessons.title: Let it be done: the optative
lessons.point: Form the optative and use it for 'should', 'let's' and wishes

lessons.title: Commands and prohibitions
lessons.point: Give commands with the aorist form, and forbid with ნუ and არ

lessons.title: I love, I have: indirect verbs and the dative subject
lessons.point: Use უყვარს, აქვს, უნდა and მოსწონს with the experiencer in the dative and the thing in the nominative

lessons.title: Having things and having people
lessons.point: Choose between აქვს for things and ჰყავს for people and animals

lessons.title: To and for someone: indirect objects
lessons.point: Mark an indirect object on the verb, including third-person ს- and ჰ-

lessons.title: For myself, for you: version
lessons.point: Use the version vowels ა-, ი-, უ- to say whom an action is for or belongs to

lessons.title: It seems I have done it: the perfect
lessons.point: Form the perfect of transitive and medial verbs, with the doer in the dative, and read its evidential sense

lessons.title: Should have, had done: the pluperfect and perfect subjunctive
lessons.point: Form the pluperfect and the perfect subjunctive and use them for missed obligations and unreal pasts

lessons.title: The perfect of intransitives
lessons.point: Form series III of class 2 verbs (დაწერილა, მისულა) from the past participle

lessons.title: Be, say, give, see: irregular and suppletive verbs
lessons.point: Use the verbs whose stems change between series: არის/იქნება/იყო, ამბობს/თქვა, აძლევს/მისცა, ხედავს/ნახა, ჭამს, სვამს, იცის

lessons.title: Reading a verb in a dictionary
lessons.point: Find a verb from its citation forms (third person present or future and masdar) and predict its screeves

lessons.title: Review: part 4 as a whole
lessons.point: Translate a passage and build and correct sentences using everything taught so far

lessons.title: How, where, when: adverbs and adverbial postpositions
lessons.point: Make adverbs with -ად, use the common adverbs of place and time, and the genitive postpositions შესახებ, გარდა, შემდეგ, წინ, უკან, მიერ

lessons.title: Bigger, biggest
lessons.point: Compare with უფრო and -ზე, say 'most' with ყველაზე, and recognise უ- -ეს-ი

lessons.title: Numbers to twenty
lessons.point: Count to twenty and keep the noun singular after a number

lessons.title: Counting in twenties
lessons.point: Build numbers up to a million on base twenty and form ordinals with მე- -ე

lessons.title: Days, months, the time
lessons.point: Tell the time, give dates and use the dative and -ში for time

lessons.title: And, but, also, even
lessons.point: Link with და, მაგრამ, ან, თუ and use the particles -ც, კი and ხომ

lessons.title: Participles: doer, done, to be done, undone
lessons.point: Read and make the four participles (მწერალი, დაწერილი, დასაწერი, დაუწერელი)

lessons.title: The verbal noun (masdar)
lessons.point: Use the masdar as a noun, with its object in the genitive

lessons.title: Myself, each other
lessons.point: Use თავი as a reflexive and ერთმანეთი as a reciprocal

lessons.title: Building words
lessons.point: Recognise the commonest affixes: სა- -ო, მე-, -ობა, -ელი, -ური, სი- -ე, უ- -ო

lessons.title: Review: part 5 as a whole
lessons.point: Translate a passage and build and correct sentences using everything taught so far

lessons.title: The one who: relative clauses
lessons.point: Make relative clauses with რომელიც, ვინც, რაც and with რომ

lessons.title: That-clauses with რომ
lessons.point: Say 'I know that...' and 'I want that...' with რომ

lessons.title: He said that: reported speech and embedded questions
lessons.point: Report speech with -ო, -მეთქი and -თქო and with რომ, and put question words inside a larger sentence

lessons.title: When, until, after
lessons.point: Make time clauses with როცა, სანამ, მას შემდეგ რაც and როგორც კი

lessons.title: Must, may, can
lessons.point: Express obligation and possibility with უნდა, შეიძლება and შეუძლია plus the optative

lessons.title: In order to
lessons.point: Express purpose with რომ and რათა plus the optative, and with the masdar

lessons.title: The present and future subjunctive
lessons.point: Recognise the two rarer subjunctive screeves and where they still occur

lessons.title: If it rains: real conditions
lessons.point: Make open conditions with თუ and the future or aorist

lessons.title: If it had rained: unreal conditions
lessons.point: Make unreal conditions with რომ and the conditional, imperfect and pluperfect

lessons.title: Because, although
lessons.point: Give reasons with რადგან, იმიტომ რომ and concede with თუმცა and მიუხედავად

lessons.title: Review: part 6 as a whole
lessons.point: Translate a passage and build and correct sentences using everything taught so far

lessons.title: Making someone do it: causatives
lessons.point: Form causatives with ა- -ინ-ებ and mark the person made to act

lessons.title: It is written: stative and resultative forms
lessons.point: Read stative verbs like აწერია and resultative passives

lessons.title: Relative intransitives with ე-
lessons.point: Use class 2 verbs with an indirect object (ეხმარება, ელოდება, ეუბნება)

lessons.title: Three people in series III
lessons.point: Say who gave what to whom in the perfect, where the indirect object moves into a -თვის phrase

lessons.title: On top of: locative version and superessive
lessons.point: Read verbs whose version vowel means 'on, over' (აწერს, აწერია)

lessons.title: Politeness and honorific verbs
lessons.point: Use თქვენ for one person politely and the honorific verbs ბრძანდება, მობრძანდით, ინებეთ

lessons.title: Verbs that change with number
lessons.point: Use verbs whose root changes for a plural subject or object (ზის / სხედან, დგას / დგანან, წევს / წვანან)

lessons.title: Apparently: turme and the evidential narrative
lessons.point: Tell a story you did not witness with the perfect and თურმე

lessons.title: Colloquial Tbilisi speech
lessons.point: Recognise the shortened forms and habits of everyday speech and when not to write them

lessons.title: Dialects and the Kartvelian family
lessons.point: Place the main Georgian dialects and Georgian's sister languages Mingrelian, Laz and Svan

lessons.title: Old Georgian and the layers of loanwords
lessons.point: Recognise Old and Middle Georgian features in older texts, and the Greek, Persian, Arabic, Turkish and Russian layers of the vocabulary

lessons.title: Review: part 7 as a whole
lessons.point: Translate a passage and build and correct sentences using everything taught so far

lessons.title: Reading 1: Proverbs
lessons.point: Read six Georgian proverbs, each a full sentence in one or two screeves

lessons.title: Reading 2: The Universal Declaration of Human Rights, Articles 1 to 3
lessons.point: Read formal modern prose with passives, participles and unda

lessons.title: Reading 3: Tbilisi, from Georgian Wikipedia
lessons.point: Read modern expository prose about the capital

lessons.title: Reading 4: Akaki Tsereteli, Suliko
lessons.point: Read the best-known Georgian song lyric, with its pluperfects and quoted speech

lessons.title: Reading 5: Ilia Chavchavadze, Letters of a Traveller
lessons.point: Read the opening of a classic of 19th-century prose, with its older spellings

lessons.title: Reading 6: Nikoloz Baratashvili, Merani
lessons.point: Read a Romantic poem of 1842 full of imperatives and optatives

lessons.title: Reading 7: Shota Rustaveli, The Knight in the Panther's Skin
lessons.point: Read two stanzas of the medieval epic and see what has changed since

lessons.title: Noun and pronoun tables
lessons.point: Look up every declension pattern and pronoun

lessons.title: Screeve tables for the four verb classes
lessons.point: Look up all eleven screeves of model verbs of each class and the irregular verbs

lessons.title: Core vocabulary
lessons.point: Find every word taught in the guide with the lesson that introduces it

lessons.title: Glossary of terms and abbreviations
lessons.point: Look up every grammatical term and gloss abbreviation

lessons.title: Annotated bibliography
lessons.point: Know which grammars, dictionaries and corpora to use next
